prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: transparent full-body landmark sprite for the established Canran learning journey.
Input roles: Image 1 is the accepted map visual master for palette, compact proportions and finish ONLY. Image 2 is the accepted first-lesson sprite for warm brown outlines, rounded approximately three-head-tall adults, softly modeled matte colors and clean alpha edges. Image 3 is this lesson's keepsake identity/story reference. Image 4, when present, specifies complete clothing and footwear, not its taller proportions.
Render one coherent compact group, friendly expressions, warm upper-left sunlight, complete heads, hands, feet and all key objects on one common ground baseline. Adults remain adults. Match the polished first-lesson sprite, not flat generic clip art and not realistic people.
Canvas: square, approximately 1254×1254; keep 10–12% transparent margin on EVERY side including beneath all shoes. Shrink the whole illustration if needed; never cut off feet. Pixels outside immediate antialiased outlines must be fully transparent. NO floor, platform, cast ground shadow, surrounding glow, colored fog, opaque matte, checkerboard, background, text, UI, stars, medal, logo or watermark. Do not copy Image 1's UI or the first lesson's faces/outfits.
Primary request: Mrs. Jones politely guides Amy as she tidies the bedroom. Exactly TWO standing adult women. LEFT Mrs. Jones: grey hair in a bun, round brown glasses, lavender long-sleeved knee-length dress with large ivory pointed collar, grey-brown tights, brown low shoes. One open hand gestures toward Amy, friendly supportive expression. RIGHT Amy: brown low ponytail tied blue, blue long-sleeved knee-length dress, ivory apron with blue pocket and blue triangular upper inset, blue-grey tights and brown low shoes. Amy holds exactly ONE wooden-handled broom with golden straw bristles, broom angled modestly inward with its full bristle tip near the common shoe baseline. The broom must not hide her feet. No bed, clothes piles, trash, wardrobe, floor or platform in the sprite; the bedroom belongs to the separate background. No maid cap, no new accessories or people. Preserve both adult identities from Image 3; Image 4 shows Amy's complete clothing and footwear. A kind cooperative scene, not scolding, no extra dialogue.
